Cell status vocabulary

  • valid-observed: admitted from retained v2 observations
  • product-failure: the product ran and failed; failure counts are shown
  • invalid-measurement: evidence exists but cannot support the claim (reason codes name why)
  • blocked: cannot be measured until a named prerequisite exists
  • unsupported: the configuration cannot express this claim
  • not-measured: no observation exists

Every comparative result published before 2026-11-01 was withdrawn; the records are retained as forensic evidence. The append-only invalidation ledger has 33 entries; 10 of them name the defect ids behind the withdrawal and 12 of them enumerate the withdrawn records by id (the rest name them by file and campaign commit). 33 of 78 history records are withdrawn without a ledger entry, by the admission rule forensic-record-not-admissible: no history record is admissible as a current claim.
